data.body: Implemented under RED->GREEN TDD. Decision recorded: retain primary-only pack scope, add a pack-layer `complete` boolean (false only when alternates present) so an alternates-backed shared clone is explicitly non-exclusive and cannot be read as the whole object store; linked-worktree pack stays complete. Portable-test gaps closed: allocation asserted from injected st_blocks (no filesystem block-policy dependence), plus direct tests for allocation-unavailable text and CLI bad-argument exit 2. schema requires pack.complete; user-guide/reuse-surface updated. make lint + make typecheck GREEN; 47 focused footprint/schema tests + 71 help/reference/registry tests GREEN (with harness GIT_CONFIG safe.bareRepository env cleared for the pre-existing bare-repo interface test, which is environmental and passes on CI). Pushed Gerrit change 2183; awaiting LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1.
